answer: Dune enters the economy only as pay: one per summit a seat clears before the judges, and the harbor stamps every dune with the seat that earned it. To vote, a seat locks dune, and the k-th seat whose locked dune carries one earner's stamp must lock 2^(k-1). An honest newcomer backed by one patron locks 1 dune. An operator staking 20 clones from one earner locks 1,048,575 dune, over a million cleared summit tasks. Spreading the stamps means each clone must clear every summit of its stake itself.
